core_obligations: Fix a Kahler metric omega_A = Theta_{A,h_A} on X with h_A = e^{-psi}, and choose gamma > max(max_j d_j/rho_j, gamma_V) so that gamma*Theta_A - Theta_V >_G 0 and gamma*Theta_A - (1/rho_j)*Theta_{O(Delta_j),h_j} > 0 for all j (proof lines 1919-1932, displayed as conditions (7.1_0) and (7.1_j) in the published article (source label key 6.2_j; the 6.x names are stale label keys, printed numbers verified against the publisher PDF 2026-10-15)).

Using the tautological sections sigma_j defining Delta_j, compute i ddbar |sigma_j|_{h_j}^{2/rho_j} and perturb the weight to psi_delta = psi + delta*sum_j |sigma_j|_{h_j}^{2/rho_j}, obtaining the lower bound i ddbar psi_delta >= (1-C delta)|xi|^2 + delta sum_j rho_j^{-2} |sigma_j|^{-2+2/rho_j}|nabla_j sigma_j|^2 (lines 1934-1949).

On the local model of the directed structure, compute the curvature tensor Q of the orbifold metric h_{V<D>,gamma,epsilon} built from the rescaled transition functions, expanding the curvature-term displays labelled 6.13_1-6.14_3 and discarding the negligible cross terms (middle of the proof, lines ~2100-2254).

Collect the non-negligible terms into the curvature estimate Q_{V<D>,gamma,epsilon} ~ gamma ddbar psi_delta |u|^2 + sum c_{lm lm} xi_l xi_m u_l u_m + epsilon(gamma ddbar psi_delta - ddbar phi)|nabla sigma(u)|^2 + epsilon/(1+epsilon|nabla sigma|^2) |nabla^2 sigma|^2 (lines 2254-2262).

Perform the orbifold substitution sigma -> sigma^{1/rho}, phi -> phi/rho, epsilon -> rho^2 epsilon to get the final curvature estimate with the orbifold correction term |nabla^2 sigma - (1-1/rho) sigma^{-1} nabla sigma nabla sigma|^2 (lines 2263-2277), then add the components Delta_j one by one to reach the multi-component statement inductively (line 2278).
proof_roadmap: Choose metrics and constants satisfying the curvature-dominance conditions (6.2_0) and (6.2_j).
Build the perturbed weight psi_delta from the tautological sections and establish its lower bound.
Compute the curvature of the local orbifold model and discard negligible terms.
Assemble the curvature estimate and apply the orbifold substitution; extend to multi-component divisors inductively.
Conclude that h_{V<D>,gamma,epsilon} is smooth off D, has the prescribed orbifold singularities, and satisfies gamma Theta_A - Theta_{V<D>} >=_G 0.
